However old you are in 1st grade, saw my dad eating the cookies and milk we left out for Santa and bringing in Christmas presents.

It was when I was 9 years old.

It was the first day back at school, and we were all talking about what we had gotten. My friend comes up to me and says "I know what you got for Christmas! You got a spiderman sofa, I saw your mom pick it out." The world stopped spinning as I stood there, shocked, barely able to reply with "But Santa got me that spiderman sofa..."

I was a total bitch to my mom later that day, but after a long talk I understood why she had "lied" to me. I also then regretted telling my younger sister on the bus ride home, but I don't think she believed me because she continued to enjoy believing in Santa.

The tradition is that they "appear" somewhere around the bed or pillow the night before 6th. So when I went to bed on 5th are forced myself to stay awake and just pretend I'm sleeping. Some time later my mom came and put some presents next to my pillow. I wasn't sad. I was actually really satisfied that I had the proof :D

P.S. We get 2nd set of presents on Christmas Eve evening but this time it's not from Santa but from the "First Star on the Sky" :)
